0.5.0 of this fork of HTML Page Viewer, for vaults that keep saved web pages as HTML, makes long
pages easier to read: it finds text in them, and shows a page's source beside the page. The fork is
not in Obsidian's community plugin directory; install it by hand.

## Install

1. Download `viell-html-page-viewer-0.5.0.zip` below.
2. Unzip it into your vault's `.obsidian/plugins/` folder, so that
   `.obsidian/plugins/viell-html-page-viewer/` holds `main.js`, `manifest.json`, and `styles.css`,
   replacing those of an earlier version.
3. In Obsidian, open **Settings → Community plugins**. If **HTML Page Viewer** is installed, turn it
   off: both plugins open `.html` and `.htm` files. Then turn on **HTML Page Viewer (viell)**, or
   turn it off and on again if it was on; if it is not listed yet, reload the list of installed
   plugins.

To go back, install 0.4.0 the same way. The plugin never changes your notes or pages.

## What is new

- **Find in page.** The search button in the toolbar, Ctrl+F (Cmd+F on macOS) while the viewer has
  focus, or the **Find in page** command opens a find bar. It finds text in the source view and,
  with scripts off, in the rendered page, ignoring case, and highlights every match, up to 10,000.
  Enter and Shift+Enter move between them, and Escape closes the bar. In a page, a match stays
  within a paragraph or another block, a space in what you type matches any run of spaces or line
  breaks, and text that the page hides is left out. The bar keeps its text when you switch views.
  The command has no hotkey of its own, so that you can give it one in Obsidian's settings.
- **Split view.** The **Split** button shows the source beside the page, or above it when the pane
  is narrow. With scripts off, the two scroll in step: scrolling one brings the other to the same
  part of the page. In the split view, the find bar finds in the source, and the page follows. A tab
  keeps the split view, as it keeps the others.

## Known limits

- With scripts on, the viewer cannot reach the page, so the find bar finds only in the source view,
  the split view's two sides scroll apart, and links work as in a browser frame.
- Stylesheets from the web do not apply, apart from Google Fonts. A local stylesheet applies only
  from a file whose name ends in `.css`.
- With scripts on, files that a script loads itself, modules that a module script imports, and
  pages in frames do not load.
- A link to a part of another page opens that page at its top.
- A file with a listed extension shows as the viewer shows any HTML file: a saved MIME archive such
  as `.mhtml` shows its encoded text, and a template its template syntax.

## Testing

Every change is tested in Obsidian 1.5.3 and 1.14.4, including finding in a page and in the source
view with the keyboard, and the split view's layout and scrolling in both directions, and a
synthetic vault of archived web pages and a mirrored site that is opened page by page and compared
with the previous fork's build. `SHA256SUMS` lists the checksums of the files below.
